mechanism.domainTask: Self-improving text-to-image generation with trajectory memory, evaluation, and targeted image editing
mechanism.populationDetail: The persistent knowledge base stores compressed workflow trajectories, not a maintained pool of candidate images or programs.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate quality-ranked elite archive is described; all trajectories are accumulated as compressed experience records.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The append-only knowledge base is trajectory memory rather than a conventional solution population; each trajectory is compressed into decision-node successes and pitfalls.
mechanism.generationDetail: Initial images are generated from scratch with Qwen-Image; when quality is below threshold and localized correction is indicated, Qwen-Image-Edit modifies the current image using evaluator suggestions.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The 0-10 aesthetic and text-image alignment subscores form an averaged scalar decision score; subscore decomposition, artifact/missing-element findings, and textual suggestions are fed to the edit loop and summarized into trajectory memory.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: A current image is the sole editable parent during a localized edit; initial generation has no image parent. Retrieved trajectories serve as auxiliary guidance, not true parents. For each new prompt, top-k=5 similar trajectories are retrieved.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: A training-free agentic diffusion workflow improves the generation process through persistent, model-specific memory of compressed trajectory outcomes and inter-agent workflow guidance, rather than evolving a conventional candidate population.

provenance.citationWarning: The existing population and parent-selection mentions are supported, but the paper also has substantial candidate-generation, reflective/meta-guidance, multi-model routing, adaptive generation, and evaluator-feedback mechanisms that are not currently cited in their corresponding survey sections. Avoid calling the creativity-level heuristic an explicit explore/exploit controller.
